purpose: Freeze the geometry sources and thresholds before evaluating whether 2019 KPHC sub-counties are spatially equivalent to KDA electoral constituencies.

subcounty.metadata_note: Metadata states the layer represents Kenya sub-county boundaries; operational layer is not claimed by KDA to be a fresh official administrative release.

constituency.provenance: Public extraction from the former IEBC vote endpoint, archived in kenya-election-data and forked in Data-Repository/kenya-election-data-shapefiles.
constituency.limitation: This is an IEBC-derived archival extraction, not a current IEBC download. It is used only as an independent geometry comparator.

field_detection.rule: String fields are selected by maximum normalized overlap with the KDA county/constituency registry; the selected fields and scores are recorded in the output.

equivalence_gate.threshold_freeze_rule: Thresholds are frozen in this contract before the geometry comparison output is generated.

publication_rule: Only KPHC candidate rows whose source sub-county passes the frozen geometry-equivalence gate may advance to value-level reconciliation; geometry pass alone does not publish a value.
